title: True Job Margin: The Job-Costing System for ServiceTitan Contractors
description: Why gross margin on the P&L lies about individual jobs, and how to cost a job honestly: labor burden (1.25-1.4x wages), materials, equipment, callbacks, unbilled change orders, simple overhead allocation, a worked $12K-job example that truly made 4%, and the weekly 20-minute job-costing review. Pure value, no pitch.
